import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List

@dataclass
class PresidioSpan:
    entity_type: str
    start: int
    end: int
    score: float

def analyze(text: str, language: str, url: str) -> List[PresidioSpan]:
    payload = json.dumps({
        "text": text,
        "language": language,
        "score_threshold": 0.35,
    }).encode("utf-8")

    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=payload,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            items = json.loads(body)
            return [
                PresidioSpan(
                    entity_type=item["entity_type"],
                    start=item["start"],
                    end=item["end"],
                    score=item["score"],
                )
                for item in items
            ]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {exc.code} from Presidio: {body}") from exc

from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

ANSI_GREEN  = "\x1b[32m"
ANSI_YELLOW = "\x1b[33m"
ANSI_RED    = "\x1b[31m"
ANSI_DIM    = "\x1b[2m"
ANSI_RESET  = "\x1b[0m"

def color_score(value: Optional[float]) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ANSI_DIM
    if value >= 0.85:
        return ANSI_GREEN
    if value >= 0.60:
        return ANSI_YELLOW
    return ANSI_RED

def print_metric_row(
    label: str,
    tp: int, fp: int, fn: int,
    precision: Optional[float],
    recall: Optional[float],
    f1: Optional[float],
    f2: Optional[float],
) -> None:
    if precision is None:
        print(
            f"  {ANSI_DIM}{label:<10}{ANSI_RESET}  "
            f"{ANSI_DIM}P=N/A   R=N/A   F1=N/A   F2=N/A   "
            f"TP={tp} FP={fp} FN={fn}{ANSI_RESET}"
        )
        return
    print(
        f"  {ANSI_DIM}{label:<10}{ANSI_RESET}  "
        f"P={color_score(precision)}{precision:.3f}{ANSI_RESET}  "
        f"R={color_score(recall)}{recall:.3f}{ANSI_RESET}  "
        f"F1={color_score(f1)}{f1:.3f}{ANSI_RESET}  "
        f"F2={color_score(f2)}{f2:.3f}{ANSI_RESET}  "
        f"{ANSI_DIM}TP={tp} FP={fp} FN={fn}{ANSI_RESET}"
    )
